name: hook-payloads
description: What each hook post body delivers: Stop's last_assistant_message, UserPromptSubmit's prompt, Notification's message, SessionEnd's reason and PostToolUse's tool_name, each with session_id and cwd. A blank or non-string value is absent; others stay untrimmed. Other hooks and bodies that are not a hook object are answered and dropped.
reason: The five hooks PowerUp installs drive the remote session; an error reply for anything else would make the hook log noise (HK-248, HK-249).
source: Sources/PowerUp/RemoteListener.swift at 4c7abe6:743-782 (event(from:), nonEmpty); RemoteListener.swift:5-25 (the verified shapes)
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.4, v1.7; docs/protocol.md spec v0. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/listener.rs listener_scenarios plays every step through protocol::listener::Listener. Swift: ProtocolServerTests drives the same rules over a real loopback socket.

steps.reason: Settings start the listener: the start stops first (generation 1), then binds 127.0.0.1 with generation 2 (RemoteListener.swift:79-135).
The bind is ready: running, no problem (RemoteListener.swift:158-161).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 1 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
